BIO-INT-004-AC01.finding: Subscriptions, permission checks, repository keys and event matching are tenant-scoped and event-type filtered.

BIO-INT-004-AC02.finding: The outbound wire payload carries the versioned ADR-0003 envelope fields with explicit snake_case serialization.

BIO-INT-004-AC03.finding: Timestamp-bound HMAC signing, atomic delivery claims, completed-result recovery, HTTPS defaults and connect-time destination enforcement protect delivery and replay boundaries.

BIO-INT-004-AC04.finding: Bounded retries and dead-letter outcomes retain a convergent per-attempt audit trail; atomic create-if-absent prevents duplicate terminal rows during concurrent repair.

BIO-INT-004-AC05.finding: The executable browser workflow proves the administration panel's empty, create, one-time-secret, enable/disable and genuine failed-create states, including an accessible alert and absence of a row or secret after failure. The authentication-settings route is explicitly documented as a HYBRID boundary because its actions remain in BIO-INT-001's sign-in/session-policy domain and none of this story's webhook ports route there.
